🇵🇭🇺🇸PHILIPPINES AND U.S. LAUNCH LARGEST EVER WAR GAMES WITH ALLIES

More than 17,000 troops are taking part in drills designed to test combat readiness under real world conditions.

Exercises include live fire operations and maritime strike scenarios near Taiwan and the South China Sea.

Japan, Canada, France and New Zealand are joining as active participants for the first time.

The drills highlight Manila’s growing security ties despite criticism from China over rising tensions.
